title: Evaluating and Mitigating Bias in Image Classifiers: A Causal Perspective Using Counterfactuals
benchmark_measurement: The paper does not measure anything related to faith or religion. It proposes and evaluates a method for generating counterfactual images to evaluate and mitigate bias in image classifiers, focusing on demographic attributes such as skin color, hair color, and age.
findings: The paper does not analyze any aspects of religion or faith; therefore, there are no findings related to religion.
